notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, own tab, no block of any kind encountered (all responses HTTP 200). robots.txt (https://www.xenos.nl/robots.txt) names only Googlebot / Googlebot-image / AdsBot-Google plus a generic User-agent:* block; no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web entry and no full-site Disallow -- only ?grid= / ?sort= filter params and vendor/customer/admin/checkout/vergelijken/print. TREE: union of (a) the /meubels mega-menu, (b) the 'Ontdek alles in meubels' tile block on the /meubels page (which exposed Loungestoelen, Bureaustoelen, Plantentafeltjes and Eettafels that the top nav did not), and (c) the full category sitemap https://www.xenos.nl/storage/sitemap/default/sitemap.xml (38,004 locs, 1,326 category paths) fetched same-origin from the loaded page. The sitemap added /meubels/kindermeubels/kinderbankjes, which appears in neither menu. QTY METHOD: every listing page server-renders its exact total inside the H1 as 'Alle <Node> (N)' (span.catalog__header-count). Cross-checked on the live rendered page for /meubels/kasten/boekenkasten: H1 badge (5) and the client-rendered div.category__product-count 'Gevonden producten: 5' agree, and exactly 5 product tiles render. Counts are node-specific and vary widely (0 to 69), so no site-wide-total artefact. Every leaf URL was confirmed HTTP 200 AND its rel=canonical equals the requested path (trap 2 check) AND its H1 names the node requested. Note child counts overlap their parent (Kasten 71 vs children summing 82; Tafeltjes 73 vs children summing 100+) because a product can sit in several children -- no summing or inference was used anywhere. LANDING PAGES, NOT LEAVES: /meubels and /tuin/tuinmeubelen render no count badge at all (pure editorial landing pages) so they are grouping rows only. /tuin/balkon likewise renders no count -> room landing page, excluded. EXCLUDED as §3 filter/facet pages (they are colour, material, shape, style or attribute refinements of a real node, not catalogue nodes): /meubels/kasten/zwart, /meubels/stoelen/{rotan,zwart,zwart-velvet}, /meubels/stoelen/eetkamerstoelen/{met-armleuning,stof,teddy,velvet}, /meubels/stoelen/fauteuils/{draaibaar,teddy}, /meubels/poefjes/{met-opbergruimte,rotan,teddy}, all 15 /meubels/tafeltjes/bijzettafels/{bamboe,beige,groen,hout,industrieel,metaal,metaal-zwart,organisch,rond,rond-hout,rond-wit,rotan,vierkant,wit,zwart}, /tuin/tuinmeubelen/{bamboe,hout,kunststof,metaal,rotan}, /tuin/tuinmeubelen/tuinstoelen/{inklapbaar,kunststof,metaal,rotan,stapelbaar}. EXCLUDED as marketing collections/series: /meubels/{bandung,charlie,java,memphis,uppsala,zaha,vintage}. STORAGE-vs-FURNITURE LINE: the whole /huishouden/opbergers branch (Household > Storage organisers) is excluded as the future Storage task. This was verified on products, not on the label: /huishouden/opbergers/opbergsystemen (11) renders 11/11 fabric hanging organisers, organiser boxes, dividers and garment/storage covers; /huishouden/opbergers/kledingrekken (1) despite its name 'clothes rails' renders a single garment COVER (kledinghoes), no rack at all; /huishouden/opbergers/schoenenrek (4) renders one genuine shoe cabinet plus two hanging fabric organisers, i.e. majority non-furniture. On that evidence the two remaining siblings /huishouden/opbergers/kapstokken (1) and /huishouden/opbergers/keukentrolleys (2) were also left out -- 3 products at stake in total. Xenos maintains a complete, explicit Meubels department and files everything it considers furniture there. ALSO EXCLUDED: /tuin/hangmatten (1, hammocks -- outdoor leisure textile, and sited outside /tuin/tuinmeubelen; the site's own Hangstoelen/hanging chairs sit inside Meubels and ARE included), /tuin/parasols and /tuin/schaduwdoeken (shade, not furniture), /tuin/tuinkussens and /tuin/buitenkleden (textiles), /woonaccessoires/{manden,opbergboeken} (baskets/storage boxes -> Storage), /woonaccessoires/wanddecoratie/wandrekken (decorative WALL shelves -> Wall Decor per the shelving line), plus all of Woonaccessoires, Tafelen, Eten en drinken, Feest, Hobby, Reizen en vrije tijd, and the /ruimtes and /woonstijlen inspiration branches. ZERO-COUNT LIVE NODES EMITTED per 7b: Eettafels (0), Kinderbankjes (0), Bistro- en balkonsets (0) -- all three return HTTP 200 with a real listing page and the site's own header reading (0). Garden furniture counts are low because this read was taken on 2026-08-20, late in the Dutch outdoor season; the numbers are the site's own current figures. Kindermeubels (6) exceeds its two children (4+0) and Tuinsets (2) exceeds its two children (0+1), i.e. a few products sit only on the parent; per §2 the parents are still grouping rows and no number was invented for them.
